s.n: Coorong smoked mullet pâté on toast
s.note: Smoked mullet whipped with cream cheese and lemon, piled on hot toast.
s.how: Flake 400g smoked mullet fillets (smoked trout works too) off the skin and bones. Beat with 150g softened cream cheese, 2 tbsp sour cream, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 1 bunch of chopped chives and plenty of black pepper until creamy but still rough. Toast 8 slices of sourdough and serve with sliced cucumber and lemon wedges.

s.note: Pipis steamed open in garlic, chilli, lemon butter, with crusty bread
s.how: Soak 1kg pipis in cold salted water for 1 hour to purge the sand, then rinse. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli in 2 tbsp olive oil for 1 minute. Add the pipis and 100ml fish stock, cover and steam 3 to 4 minutes until they open, discarding any that stay shut. Stir in 30g butter, the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

m.n: Hideaway Tom's crisp fish and chips
m.note: Battered white fish with chicken salt chips and homemade tartare
m.how: Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water into a batter. Dust 4 firm white fish fillets in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped capers, pickles and dill for tartare. Toss the chips in chicken salt and serve wrapped in paper with lemon.

w.note: Apples baked soft with honey, sultanas and cinnamon, with cream.
w.how: Core 4 large Granny Smith apples and score a line around the middle of each. Stand them in a baking dish, fill with a mix of 60g sultanas, 40g softened butter, 3 tbsp honey and 1 tsp cinnamon, pour 100ml hot water into the dish and bake at 180C for 45 minutes, spooning the juices over twice, until soft. Serve warm with cream.

d.n: Coorong shack black tea with honey
d.note: Strong black tea with honey and milk, poured hot from the pot.
d.how: Boil 1.2 litres of water, pour it over 6 black tea bags in a large teapot and steep for 4 minutes. Stir in 4 tbsp honey, pour into mugs and serve with 300ml of warm milk on the side.
